name: OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells titanium products in Japan, the United States of America, China, and internationally. The company offers titanium sponges, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, titanium tetrachloride aqueous solutions, and ferro-titanium products; and high-performance materials, including titanium powder, high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide, as well as gas-atomized titanium powder.
